steps.title: [MAIN ONLY] IF you followed this …
steps.text: [MAIN ONLY] IF you followed this guide on your main you can start working on your other skills now while making on of the alts listed above

steps.title: If you are not 82 magic, …
steps.text: If you are not 82 magic, alch during agility and keep splashing as 0time

steps.title: 56 agility (for shortcut in GOTR) …
steps.text: 56 agility (for shortcut in GOTR) Varrock course > buy graceful gloves and cape > do shaziyen adv. course @48 > wildy course @52 DONT FORGET SUMMER PIES!@!@

steps.title: Get Raiments of the eye outfit …
steps.text: Get Raiments of the eye outfit + abyssal needle (Quest up your alt during GOTR, train/play the alt during mud rc)

steps.title: Buy ring of the elements from …
steps.text: Buy ring of the elements from GE

steps.title: Start crafting Mud runes at the …
steps.text: Start crafting Mud runes at the Water altar (see the sheet for gp/hr figures).

steps.title: Note: steam runes at the fire …
steps.text: Note: steam runes at the fire altar are also a viable option. slightly more xp but less profit

steps.title: Once you have 100m GP get …
steps.text: Once you have 100m GP get 99 craft with air b staves. 100m allows you to buy 11k staves+orbs (4.5h of crafting), go back to rc when selling takes a while
steps.note: Craft d'hide bodies (green -> blue -> red -> black dragonhide) near a bank - fastest to 99.
